obernants.operator: Neville and Newton represent the same unique real polynomial of degree<n from common samples. Their traversal differs: Neville updates ascending rolling widths; Newton builds descending divided-difference columns and evaluates by nested products. Comparisons require finite scale-aware tolerance, not exact equality; extrapolation is admitted but may amplify error.
